description: Session-cookie authentication round trip against kvmd 4.186, plus every way the endpoints refuse one, recorded by hand with httpx (see README). Credentials are placeholders.

steps.name: login_json_body
steps.note: kvmd's login handler reads form fields; a JSON body arrives as empty user/passwd

result.error_msg: The argument '' is not a valid username characters

steps.name: login_wrong_passwd
steps.note: credentials the validators accept but the auth manager rejects

steps.name: login_invalid_user
steps.note: user name fails valid_user's regex before any lookup happens

result.error_msg: The argument 'ADMIN!' is not a valid username characters

steps.name: login_invalid_expire
steps.note: expire is validated as a non-negative number

result.error_msg: The argument 'abc' is not a valid expiration time

steps.name: check_with_cookie
steps.note: session cookie accepted, no X-KVMD-* headers sent

steps.name: check_without_credentials
steps.note: no header, cookie or basic auth at all

steps.name: logout_without_cookie
steps.note: authorized by X-KVMD-* headers, but the handler needs the cookie to know which session to drop; the token value is hidden from the message by the validator

result.error_msg: The argument is not a valid auth token
